sources.label: Visualping home
sources.claim: Visualping watches pixels, copy, or a selected box on the page, with email and other alerts on paid plans.

sources.label: Visualping Meta Ad Library playbook
sources.claim: Visualping has a public guide for monitoring a competitor's Meta Ad Library page: paste the library URL, pick a cadence, and get visual diffs when new ads appear.

sources.label: Visualping pricing page
sources.claim: Visualping publishes a free plan and paid plans up to $350; checks are metered and expire monthly.

sources.label: Visualping on false positives
sources.claim: Visualping's own writing says most detected changes are not important, and that false positives will never reach zero.
